people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
translations.bsb: “Speak to us yourself and we will listen,” they said to Moses. “But do not let God speak to us, or we will die.”
translations.kjv: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
translations.asv: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear; but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
